newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Boulevard eyes 2.7 bln peso investments.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Boulevard eyes 2.7 bln peso investments.

text.p: Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc is earmarking 2.7 billion pesos for the construction of a deluxe hotel and a condominium near the Manila's Makati financial district, a company official said on Monday.

President Abelardo Villacorta told reporters 1.7 billion pesos would be earmarked for the 300-room hotel and another one billion pesos would be allocated for the 28-storey building to be built in the Fort Bonifacio district.
Villacorta said negotiations with two international hotel chains have started for the hotel project.
Boulevard is selling 500 million shares or 50 percent of its shares to the public. Its listing date is on April 28.

Boulevard is one of that 13 companies which form part of a consortium awarded the right to develop the 214-hectare tract of land in Bonifacio. Boulevard has acquired a 5,500 square metre lot inside the former military camp.
